name: Office
description: Location, other than a hospital, skilled nursing facility (SNF), military treatment facility, community health center, or state facility, where the health professional routinely provides health services.

name: Home
description: Location, other than a hospital or other facility, where the patient receives care in a private residence.

name: Inpatient Hospital
description: A facility, other than psychiatric, which primarily provides diagnostic, therapeutic, and surgical services under medical supervision.

name: Outpatient Hospital
description: A portion of a hospital which provides diagnostic, therapeutic, and surgical services to patients who do not require inpatient hospitalization.
